subject: Performance demo: latency benchmark review — final slot & preflight checklist
messages:
From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>
To: James Park <james.park@fastretail.com>
Cc: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.ai>, Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.ai>
Date: Tue, 05 May 2027 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Performance readout — latency benchmark week of May 10?

Hi James —

Thanks again for running workloads with us last week. We captured the full latency traces and have a concise set of slides and a short demo-ready set of token-level graphs we'd like to walk through. Goal: align on observed tail-latency, batching profile, and suggested configuration changes that impact cost/latency tradeoffs.

Who from your side should join for the readout? We usually run 45–60 minutes:
- 10 min context & experiment scope
- 25–30 min results & callouts (tail p95/p99, KV/cache behavior)
- 10–15 min ops Q&A and next steps

Available slots (PDT) next week:
- Tue 5/11 10:00–11:00
- Wed 5/12 14:00–15:00
- Thu 5/13 09:00–10:00 or 10:00–11:00

If none of those work, tell us a couple of windows and we’ll flex. I’ve CC’d Karthik (SE) for technical prep and Laura (solutions ops) on logistics.

Attachments: redwood-benchmark-20270505-summary.pdf (slides + highlights).

Best,
Marissa Cole
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
marissa.cole@redwood.ai
[Attachment: redwood-benchmark-20270505-summary.pdf (pdf, 2.4MB)]
From: James Park <james.park@fastretail.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>, Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.ai>
Cc: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.ai>, Anita Rao <anita.rao@fastretail.com>, Procurement <procurement@fastretail.com>
Date: Wed, 06 May 2027 11:30:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Performance readout — latency benchmark week of May 10?

Hi Marissa —

Thanks — this looks good. We want the following people on the call:
- Anita Rao (Security) — must confirm crypto/config details and evidence for SOC2 control mapping
- CloudOps (for infra config and logs)
- Procurement (for any SOW/terms follow-up)

Preference from Procurement: Thu 5/13 in the morning is ideal. Security also prefers earlier in the week but can make Thursday if we lock it now. Can we do Thu 5/13 10:00–11:00 PT? Make it 60 minutes to leave buffer.

Also: Can your team provide an operations runbook and a short list of exact model/configs used (quantization, batch sizes, sequence lengths)? Anita will need that ahead of time to triage potential compliance questions.

Thanks — I’ll add a tentative hold once we confirm.

—James
James Park
Staff SRE, FastRetail
james.park@fastretail.com
From: Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.ai>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>, Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.ai>, Vivek Kulkarni <vivek_kulkarni@redwood.ai>
Date: Fri, 07 May 2027 08:45:00 -0700
Subject: RE: Performance readout — preflight TODOs (internal)

Team —

Per James’s reply, we should lock Thu 5/13 10:00–11:00 PT and prepare the following preflight artifacts for Anita/CloudOps/Procurement at least 48 hours before the call:
- Ops runbook (how to reproduce the run + env vars, command lines) — owner: Karthik
- Minimal configuration manifest (model name + quantization, max_seq_len, batch_profile) — owner: Marissa/Karthik
- Token-level tail-latency CSV and p95/p99 tables — owner: Karthik
- Short security FAQ (data flows, retention, tenant isolation) — owner: Vivek
- Slides: 1 slide per outcome + 1 action slide with recommended changes — owner: Marissa

I’ve created a short preflight checklist (attached) and a Drive folder for artifacts. Please drop artifacts in the Drive link and ping me when uploaded.

Laura Bennett
Solutions Ops, Redwood Inference
laura_bennett@redwood.ai
[Attachment: preflight-checklist.xlsx (xlsx, 45KB)]
From: Anita Rao <anita.rao@fastretail.com>

Cc: CloudOps Team <cloudops@fastretail.com>, Procurement <procurement@fastretail.com>
Date: Sun, 09 May 2027 17:05:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Performance readout — latency benchmark week of May 10?

Hi Marissa —

Quick security asks so we can scope the review:
1) SOC 2 artefacts or attestation (if available) — or a brief summary of controls mapped to data handling for inference traffic
2) List of endpoints, whether any customer data is persisted during the benchmarking runs, and log retention policy
3) Any network diagrams showing isolation between tenants (VPC, subnets)

If you can drop a one-pager and the runbook by Tue 5/11 EOD, we can triage internally. Otherwise we risk needing an extra follow-up call.

Thanks —
Anita Rao
Security Engineer, FastRetail
